notes: Generated by scripts/data/fetch-donki.ts from https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI/WS/get/FLR and /SEP, 2014-01-01 to 2019-12-31 (raw responses in data/raw/donki/). Kept 379 M-class and 22 X-class flares out of 478 flare records, and 36 SEP days out of 52 SEP records (one per detecting instrument; first record of each day kept). Times are flare peak times and SEP event times as reported. Severity is the game mapping of GAME_DESIGN §5.6 (M1 = 0.30 … M9.9 = 0.55, X1 = 0.60 … X10+ = 1.0, SEP = 0.8); the class and time are the real record.
